scope: C-014 strict data-rights transport, revision discovery, zero-body 24-hour export manifest/download, 2 MiB whole-response limit, seven-day account deletion status grant, challenge-scoped confirmation, TX-09 guards, four-scope restricted cleanup, failure-preserving retry, receipt/restore deny, retention due reconstruction and client cache invalidation

assertions: export, DAY, MATTER, RELATIONSHIP_DATA and ACCOUNT requests are strict and reject client guard/epoch fields
relationship selected dates and expected revisions must match in exact order
ACCOUNT confirm requires a challenge-scoped identity verification ref
DELETE and EXPORT completion semantics are split; a successful export requires READY/EXPIRED/INVALIDATED artifact metadata and cannot claim erasure timestamps
DataRightsSummary, one-task status grant and export document are strict and reject internal ref, fingerprint, epoch and unknown fields
authenticated summary/list and DAY delete bind the owner from the session, expose only approved revisions and reject unknown deletion fields
ACCOUNT prepare, one-time WeChat reauth and confirm remain distinct challenge-bound calls and return one plaintext status token while the store receives only its hash
ordinary Bearer cannot enter the status-only endpoint; DeletionStatus reads only its bound task
READY download is a no-store JSON attachment without a generic envelope, token, seed, Prompt, provider, epoch or source fingerprint
export creates a DataTaskView while RELATIONSHIP_DATA prepare/confirm freezes an explicit empty DAY vector

T-C014-DB-001.selector: C-014 PG18 TX-09, restricted cleanup, receipt and account destruction
assertions: real PostgreSQL 18 rejects ordinary API reads of restricted DataTask rows and applies the complete migration/catalog role boundary
DAY confirm synchronously commits one guard before the Restricted Worker physically removes the day and writes DayErasureGuard, restore deny and deletion receipt

MATTER deletion removes the exact matter, its dependency and ciphertext fragment while preserving a prevalidated fallback; RELATIONSHIP_DATA with an empty selected-day vector removes relationship facts and preserves the real DAY
summary returns current account/relationship revisions without internal refs
same export command returns one task; Restricted Worker freezes a minimal source vector and creates one READY 24-hour manifest with no body/content/object column
repeated READY reads return the same source, correction invalidates the old manifest, and the exact 24-hour boundary expires it
retention due is rebuilt from PostgreSQL and expires READY metadata without Redis as a fact source

wrong identity cannot verify an ACCOUNT challenge; verification command replay preserves the original TTL and cross-challenge command reuse conflicts; confirm revokes the session and creates one guarded task
an active legal hold leaves the original ACCOUNT task FAILED and account DELETING; after release a revision-scoped due event retries the same task and succeeds
wrong status token is rejected, FAILED remains readable on the same grant, and the first SUCCEEDED read consumes the grant
ACCOUNT completion destroys identity material and creates a six-month de-identified receipt without a blinded account token
all four restricted event capabilities call closed database functions with only task ref, revision/guard when applicable and execution time
export finalization hashes only the revision vector and persists no body; retention due uses a separate closed purge function
the queue handler payload contains no openid, note, checkin, ciphertext, expression body or target key

T-C014-RESILIENCE-001.selector: C-014 PG18 TX-09, restricted cleanup, receipt and account destruction
assertions: confirmation commits the deletion guard before any Restricted Worker execution and ordinary source rows remain blocked while the worker is absent
an active legal hold keeps the original ACCOUNT task FAILED and DELETING, then a new revision-scoped due event retries the same task
a deterministic third-step restore-deny failure records RESTRICTED_EVIDENCE FAILED, keeps ACCOUNT DELETING after online cleanup, and succeeds on the same task after restart
the synchronous DAY guard response clears daily, evening and weekly local caches
offline data-rights reads and writes are not queued or persisted
ACCOUNT confirm stores only one status grant in restricted local storage, clears ordinary caches and removes the token after terminal success
